recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core source work is needed unless the work group later decides the examples must prefer subject:Patient.name over the existing Observation.patient search parameter.
issue_request: FHIR-45306 was Applied with resolution Persuasive with Modification for R6. It asked for search and _filter examples that describe observations for a patient to use an explicitly patient-specific chained search instead of the broader Observation.subject chain.
initial_application: Upstream commit 1d29a98d3d2f8e140eb23843984a6f2177fbe645 from PR 3967 changed the affected examples in source/search.html and source/search_filter.html from subject.name/subject.id to patient.name/patient.id. That commit did not include an AutoFHIR issue-reconcile trailer.
additional_context: The Jira resolution says the original examples were not technically wrong, but examples whose prose says patient should be patient-specific. The current Observation-patient SearchParameter is defined as Observation.subject.where(resolve() is Patient) with target Patient, so patient.name is a patient-specific chained search. FHIR-I minutes for 2024-05-13 confirm the Persuasive with Mod 9-0-0 vote; no conflicting Zulip or additional Confluence FTS evidence was found.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The combined branch received an empty audit commit because the current source already satisfies the applied issue and no existing Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-45306 was present.
